subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streams treat the configured request timeout as a progress-refreshed idle timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling guarded streaming transports, once live proof is added?
rationale: The code path and sibling contract support the PR, but changing timeout semantics for an existing provider can affect long-running user setups and needs explicit maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
options.body: Require a redacted slow or remote Ollama run that completes after this patch, then allow the native stream timeout to match sibling streaming transports.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout semantics
options.body: Reject this branch and ask for a different fix that preserves the existing total-duration cap for native Ollama streams.

options.title: Add an explicit opt-in
options.body: Request a separate compatibility design for users who need progress-refreshed Ollama streams without changing the default timeout behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept idle-timeout parity after proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted slow or remote Ollama run that completes after this patch, then allow the native stream timeout to match sibling streaming transports.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history shows repeated provider-runtime and Ollama timeout work, making this the strongest available owner signal for the compatibility choice.
